events.title: 37 spirit beasts. Which one would you raise first?
events.summary: There are 37 of them, and you raise one at a time. Linwu: Spirit Beast Ranch is a monster-raising game in the spirit of the ones we grew up on. Pick your beast, then make it yours. Drills, meals, rest, praise. Swim it across a lake, send it up a mountain, feed it the fish it likes. It has a mind of its own. When it does not trust you yet, it ignores your commands mid-fight.
